auto_clarifications: Scan production admin UI route handlers, projection services, generated contracts, built production assets, navigation/bootstrap responses, and route response probes; categorize test/docs/QA/historical paths by policy.

Block fixed QA markers and fixture-like IDs in production code/assets/responses when they masquerade as domain data; allow them in tests, QA, docs, manifests, and historical specs with explicit categorization.

Scan production-shipped built assets/manifests for prohibited user-visible fixture/domain markers while ignoring hashes, generated module identifiers, sourcemap-only references, and schema names unless they surface fake domain data.
Authenticate route probes with deterministic local-principal and Auth0-shaped platform/tenant principals; fail closed when an authorized probe is missing.
Seed representative persisted records for completed live-data admin surfaces and a fresh empty-state path; document computed/empty routes with no seed requirement when appropriate.

Delete or disconnect obsolete deterministic production builders after production imports are gone; retain fixtures only under test, QA, docs, or historical-spec boundaries with policy entries and rollback guidance.
